s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket containing the identity snapshot artifacts.

s3_prefix.description: S3 key prefix for the target snapshot (e.g. snapshots/identity-snapshot-20260523T120000Z).

dry_run.description: When true, analyse divergence and return a report without making changes. Always run dry_run first.

max_batch.description: Maximum number of accounts to reconstitute in a single execution. Enforces a safety cap.
